# enma-lsp

VS Code extension + stdio LSP for Enma, Perception's JIT-compiled C++-flavored scripting language.

Repository: https://github.com/sinnafuls/enma-lsp
Extension ID: sin.enma-language   File extension: .em   Predefined surfaces: .em.predefined

---
## Enma language quick-reference

C++-flavored syntax, AOT+JIT-compiled to native, no garbage collector.

### Primitive types
  int8 int16 int32 int64   uint8 uint16 uint32 uint64
  float32 float64   bool   char   string   void
  aint32 aint64  (atomic variants — require `import "atomic";`)

### Composite types
  class  struct  interface  enum  enum class  namespace  template<typename T>

### Qualifiers
  const  nullable  out  volatile

### Heap
  T* p = new T(args);   T* a = new T[N];   delete p;   delete[] a;

### Closures
  [capture](params) -> RetType { body }   // explicit return type
  [](params) => expr                      // expression body

### f-strings
  f"value={x}"   // depth >= 2: f"outer={f"inner={y}"}"

### Annotations
  [[packed]]  [[align(N)]]  [[dll("lib.dll")]]  [[budget(N)]]  [[inline]]

### Coroutines
  coroutine int32 producer() { yield 1; }
  coroutine_t handle = producer();

### Pattern matching
  int32 r = match (x) { 0 => 100, 1 => 200, _ => 0 };

### defer
  defer { cleanup(); }   // LIFO, runs at scope exit

### Pointer rules
  value.field   ptr->field   *ptr

### Imports
  import "vec";   // required for any stdlib module (see below)

### Other features
  Multi-inheritance + interfaces, operator overloading, properties (get/set),
  try/catch/throw, switch/match, variadic (...) with __va_count/__va_arg(i),
  designated struct initializers {.x=0,.y=0}, function references @fn,
  intrinsics __asm_rdtsc()/__asm_pause(), preprocessor #include/#define/#ifdef

---
## Stdlib modules (all require explicit import)

  string arrays maps math math3d simd variant atomic bits time regex
  thread vec hash_set sorted_map list json hash

Auto-registered without import: println  format  assert  sleep_ms  (core)

---
## Perception API (auto-registered, no import needed)

  lifecycle    register_routine(name, fn)   main()   unload callback
  render       draw_text  draw_rect  draw_line  draw_circle  get_font*
  proc         proc_t handle type
               ref_process(pid_or_name)         // acquire
               read_typed<T>(proc, addr)         // memory read
               write_typed<T>(proc, addr, val)   // memory write
               find_code_pattern(proc, aob)      // AOB scan → address
               get_module_list  get_module_base  alloc_vm  dereference
  cpu          CPU info, CPUID, perf counters
  filesystem   file read/write/enumerate
  sound        audio playback
  zydis        disassembly (Zydis backend)
  win          Win32 API surface
  input        keyboard/mouse hooks
  unicorn      CPU emulation (Unicorn backend)
  net          http_get(url)  http_post(url, body)  ws_connect(url)  udp

Full surface with all overloads + doc comments:
  server/src/predefined/perception.em.predefined

---
## LSP setup for AI coding tools

### Claude Code
~/.claude/lsp.json (or workspace .claude/lsp.json):

  {
    "enma": {
      "command": ["node", "/abs/path/to/enma-lsp/bin/enma-language-server.js"],
      "extensions": [".em", ".em.predefined"]
    }
  }

Or: claude mcp add enma-lsp node /abs/path/to/enma-lsp/bin/enma-language-server.js

### Build first (required)
  git clone https://github.com/sinnafuls/enma-lsp.git
  cd enma-lsp && npm install && npm run compile

The launcher (bin/enma-language-server.js) defaults to --stdio; no flag needed
for non-VS Code clients.

### Other editors
Full configs for Neovim (3 paths), Helix, Zed, Sublime LSP, JetBrains, Cursor,
Antigravity, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot CLI → docs/standalone-lsp.md

---
## Perception MCP (for AI agents interacting with a live Perception instance)

### Enable & connect
  Perception Settings → MCP → toggle on, note the port.
  claude mcp add --transport http perception http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp

### ALWAYS call script/get_context first
  Enma is proprietary — model training data is incomplete. This tool returns
  the current API surface, active scripts, and session facts. Skipping it
  produces stale or incorrect completions.

### Address precision
  Use hex strings ("0x7ff800001234") — never JSON numbers. JS loses precision
  past 2^53, which is below typical 64-bit addresses.

### Handle lifecycle
  Acquire via reference_by_pid / reference_by_name. Call dereference when done.
  Handles are not auto-released.

### 59 tools covering
  Process enumeration   list_processes  reference_by_pid  reference_by_name
                        dereference  get_process_info
  Memory R/W            read_memory  write_memory  read_typed  write_typed
                        alloc_vm  free_vm  protect_vm
  Modules               get_module_list  get_module_base  get_module_info
                        get_module_exports  get_module_imports
  PE analysis           pe_headers  pe_sections  pe_exports  pe_imports
  Scanning              find_code_pattern  scan_aob  scan_value  scan_string
  Cross-references      find_xrefs_to  find_xrefs_from
  Signatures            generate_signature  ida_sig_to_aob
  RTTI / symbols        rtti_scan  symbol_lookup  demangle
  Vtables               vtable_scan  vtable_resolve
  Disassembly           disassemble  disassemble_function  disassemble_range
  Enma scripts          script/get_context  script/execute  script/validate
                        script/list  script/stop

Full guide with examples → docs/mcp-for-ai.md

  server/src/predefined/perception.em.predefined   Perception API surface (LSP source of truth)

  docs/standalone-lsp.md                           Editor setup guide

  AGENTS.md                                        Contributing guide for AI agents
  samples/showcase.em                              One of every grammar construct
  example/                                         Larger examples: proc, math, net, zydis, unicorn…
  syntaxes/enma.tmLanguage.json                    TextMate grammar
  snippets/enma.code-snippets                      ~70 language snippets
  snippets/stdlib.code-snippets                    stdlib snippets

## Build & test

  npm install && npm run compile   # tsc + copy-predefined + esbuild
  npm test                         # 1078 passing unit tests

Tests cover: parser (round-trip, error recovery), completer, hover, signature help,
formatter, go-to-definition, find-references, rename, predefined loader, bundler,
diagnostics engine.
